name: rakotis
description: Shared MLS-over-WebSocket relay chat orchestration for Enigma and Aurora: a Rotor-backed crypto bridge, the relay chat transport, the chat-channel composable and the MLS envelope state machine (mls_key_package / mls_welcome / mls_commit / mls_app, participants, reconnect). No P2P/WebRTC, no voice calls, no product UI; does not reimplement crypto.
